name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain=graphics>_<descriptor> name. Descriptor accurately reflects use: the fast (per-call) palette/tile-frame index selected while a char is walking (walk_anim_phase != 0), distinct from the slow ambient idx at 0x53C0B used when idle. 'idx' reflects the scalar index/counter datatype. No Ghidra address residue: the 0..3 range and ==4 wrap are domain (palette-cycle) semantics, not address bits; the name carries no hex suffix. The decompiler-internal alias 'chapter_save_load_buffer_ptr' seen in caller plates is a stale Ghidra label for this address, not the live primary symbol.
purpose: Fast palette/tile-frame animation phase (0..3) for chapter visuals; selects the alternate frame painted while a character is in walk animation.
logic_summary: Advanced once per call of fd2_tick_chapter_palette_animation (unconditional INC, CMP ==4, reset-to-0 => cycles 0,1,2,3). Read by fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos (0x12904) and fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_with_mode (0x1dacf): when a runtime_char is moving (pSprite_state[2]/walk_anim_phase != 0) this index is the animated-frame selector; idle chars use the slow ambient idx (0x53C0B) instead. A '3 -> 1' fold then applies before sprite lookup. Runs faster than the ambient idx (which is gated by 4-BIOS-tick elapsed).
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar = current animation phase, constrained 0..3 by the writer (INC / CMP ==4 / reset). All readers load it with a plain 32-bit MOV (no sign idiom); contrast the neighboring signed ambient idx at 0x53C0B which uses the SAR divide idiom. Used as a frame/palette index into the per-char sprite table.
notes: Existing src comment block (palette.c lines 45-57) is precise, ASCII-only, and every claim verified against disassembly (writer 0x129d2-0x129e1 dword INC/CMP4/reset; reader 0x12904 MOV EDX,dword ptr [0x53c07] plain 32-bit). Kept verbatim. Ghidra data plate at 0x53C07 was empty (<null>) so a concise plate was created (PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline) distilling the src conclusion. is_const=false: real game write-xref from fd2_tick_chapter_palette_animation (0x129e1 MOV [0x53c07],0). Mutable zero-init .object2 scalar (memory all zeros, no static seed).
